description: This file implements a PHP class 'gitlab' providing an API wrapper for GitLab REST API v4, including methods for issue management, project retrieval, and HTTP request handling, tailored for TestLink integration.

classes.name: gitlab
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with GitLab's REST API, including issue and project management, with support for proxy configuration and cURL setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the gitlab object with URL, API key, project ID, and optional configuration, including proxy settings.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Sets up cURL with default options and proxy configuration if provided.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the web URL of a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue from GitLab.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of issues for the project.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with a title and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note/comment to an existing issue.

methods.name: getProjectByIdentity
methods.description: Fetches project details by its identifier.

methods.name: getIssueStatuses
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to retrieve issue statuses.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an API request and decodes JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method and handles response.
